name: DeFi TVL elevated regime + RSI dip — buy dips while capital sits in DeFi (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why DeFi TVL leads the dip-buy): total value locked in DeFi is capital actively committed to on-chain risk — when TVL is elevated, participants are leaning IN (risk-on), and dips within that regime are shaken-out longs re-entered, not the start of a bear. TVL is a slow-moving risk-appetite gauge that frames whether a dip is a buy; it turns regime BEFORE the fast price tape confirms. So we require defi_tvl above a fitted floor (risk-on regime) AND an RSI dip (the entry timing), and exit when TVL falls below its exit level (capital leaving = regime over). Distinct from defi-tvl-momentum (which chases inflows): this BUYS DIPS under a TVL regime. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain RSI-dip buy without the TVL gate matches the deflated Sharpe, TVL adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2 (non-stationarity): TVL grew ~orders of magnitude, so a fitted USD floor can be always-true — the Gate must reject a degenerate level. Data knowable T+1. tier1, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: defi_tvl is above a fitted floor (capital committed to DeFi = risk-on regime) while RSI has dipped.
